title: draft door: a first draft save of a published item with the ifMatch that get_metadata_item returned is refused METADATA_CONFLICT (current is null)
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjR8PEo6YbHGktD3s5a

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed task. Milestone 1 child of the cloud epic objectstack-ai/cloud#5027.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：用轻门改一个已发布、还没有草稿的项时，按工具说明带上读到的 version 作为 ifMatch，第一次保存必然被拒（409）。
- 影响：实测 12 次改已发布项有 9 次撞上；模型每次都靠去掉 ifMatch 过关，白费一轮，乐观锁也被绕开。
- 要你做什么：不需要，按队列排期即可。

## Bug
Change an item that is published and has no draft: `get_metadata_item` returns the published `version` token (`hmac-sha256:…`). Passing it as `ifMatch` to `save_metadata_draft`, as the tool description says ("the `version` a read or a save answered"), is refused:

```
METADATA_CONFLICT · object/mcrm_customer has been modified since you loaded it. The version token sent is not the current version (current is null).
```

There is no draft head yet, so the comparison is against `null`. Hit in 9 of 12 trial sessions (Haiku 5.5, 2026-11-26, main @6c290d3a); every time the model retried without `ifMatch`.

## What to do
1. On a first draft save, compare `ifMatch` with the published head when no draft head exists.
2. Still refuse when the published item changed after the read, naming the current version.
3. Align the `version` / `ifMatch` wording of `get_metadata_item` and `save_metadata_draft` with the fixed behaviour.

## Acceptance
- Read a published item, save it unchanged with that `ifMatch`: accepted first time.
- Another caller saves a draft after the read; a save with the old `ifMatch` is refused.

## References
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.ts:342-346` (`ifMatch` description), `:811-836` (save path)
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save-conflict.ts`

Suggested-grade: p1 · every edit through the door wastes a round and teaches clients to drop the concurrency check.
Dedupe: "ifMatch draft", "METADATA_CONFLICT current is null" found no open card.
